info.paymentTitle: A clear path from order to shared gift.
info.paymentIntro: Bloomora’s initial payment flow uses an administrator-managed QRIS image and manual verification.
info.step1Body: Shape your gift and preview it before payment. The server selects the package price and limits from the active configuration.
info.step2Body: Use the QRIS image displayed for the current order. Do not trust screenshots or payment instructions copied from another order.
info.step3Body: Submit proof through the authenticated order flow. File type, size, ownership, and order association are validated server-side.
info.step4Body: An authorized administrator reviews the proof. Publication is available only when the order reaches the configured verified state.

about.title: Digital gifts that feel like a little room of your own.
about.intro: Bloomora is for moments too personal for a generic card, but not meant to become a large project.

sections.heading: We believe in small details.
sections.body: One right sentence, a photograph only you understand, or a surprise that opens slowly can turn a gift into a memory.

sections.heading: Made with quiet intention.
sections.body: We choose considered templates, just-enough interaction, and honest language so attention stays with the person you love.

sections.heading: No made-up claims.
sections.body: Bloomora is still growing. Pricing, lifetime, media retention, and support follow active business configuration.

contact.title: Have something you want to ask?
contact.intro: Send a message through the owner-configured support channel. The address and support hours should be updated before public launch.

sections.heading: Product support
sections.body: For questions about templates, the editor, expired gifts, or payment flow, include non-sensitive details so we can help.

sections.heading: Payment questions
sections.body: Never send passwords, payment credentials, or private media by email. Official payment status comes only from your order.

sections.heading: Current contact
sections.body: hello@bloomora.example — a placeholder address that must be replaced with a business support channel before use.

faq.title: A little clarity before you begin.
faq.intro: These answers describe currently planned product behavior. Final policy follows active business configuration.

sections.heading: Do I need coding experience?
sections.body: No. Choose a template, add your words and memories, and preview it.

sections.heading: Can a gift open without an app?
sections.body: Yes. Recipient gifts are designed to open through a responsive web link.

sections.heading: How does payment work?
sections.body: Bloomora uses admin-managed QRIS and manual verification. Final amount comes from the active package on the server.

sections.heading: What happens when a gift expires?
sections.body: The link shows an expired state according to the package lifetime. Extension and media retention follow owner configuration.

privacy.title: Your attention stays yours.
privacy.intro: This is an editable policy framework for the owner to complete before public launch and is not legal advice.

sections.heading: Account and gift data
sections.body: Bloomora processes account data, gift drafts, media, and order status to provide the features you request.

sections.heading: Media and links
sections.body: Media must belong to an authorized account or gift. Do not upload material you do not own or have permission to share.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.body: Gift lifetime and media deletion policy must be specified by the owner before production.

terms.title: A space made with clarity.
terms.intro: This terms framework must be reviewed and completed with business identity, applicable law, and official procedures before launch.

sections.heading: Use in good faith
sections.body: You are responsible for uploaded content, your right to share it, and who receives the gift link.

sections.heading: Configured features
sections.body: Pricing, lifetime, media limits, templates, and music may change with active business configuration.

sections.heading: No unapproved promises
sections.body: Bloomora must not show guarantees, legal identity, or final refund policy before owner approval.

refunds.title: Clear boundaries for manual payment.
refunds.intro: This page explains safe boundaries before an official refund policy is configured and approved by the owner.

sections.heading: Before verification
sections.body: A manual order may remain pending while an administrator reviews proof. Uploading proof is not approval.

sections.heading: If proof is rejected
sections.body: Status and rejection reasons must come from an official administrator through your order. Correction instructions follow business configuration.

sections.heading: Final policy
sections.body: Deadlines, refund conditions, fees, and escalation channels must be completed before production payments are enabled.

expiration.title: Every moment gets a clear boundary.
expiration.intro: Gift lifetime comes from the selected package and server-stored timestamp, not interface language.

sections.heading: While active
sections.body: Recipients can open the link while the gift is active and payment entitlement is satisfied.

sections.heading: When it expires
sections.body: The recipient page shows an expired state and does not imply the gift is still available.

sections.heading: Extension
sections.body: Extension may only change lifetime through an official flow and server calculation.

media.title: Photos and audio deserve care.
media.intro: User media is not translated by an interface-language change and must not be replaced without approval.

sections.heading: Rights and safety
sections.body: Upload only photos or audio you own or have permission to share. The server should validate type, size, ownership, and access.

sections.heading: Approved music
sections.body: Built-in music must come from approved rights-safe sources. Bloomora does not provide unlicensed commercial music.

sections.heading: Deletion
sections.body: Retention periods and deletion requests follow active business policy.
